body: gpt-oss-safeguard-120b and gpt-oss-safeguard-20b are two open-weight reasoning models post-trained from the gpt-oss models and trained to reason from a provided policy in order to label content under that policy. In this report, we describe gpt-oss-safeguard’s capabilities and provide our baseline safety evaluations on the gpt-oss-safeguard models, using the underlying gpt-oss models as a baseline. For more information about the development and architecture of the underlying gpt-oss models, see the original gpt-oss model model card⁠.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布gpt-oss-safeguard技术报告，推出gpt-oss-safeguard-120b和20b两款开源权重推理模型。该模型基于gpt-oss基础模型进行后训练，专门用于根据给定安全策略进行推理并标记违规内容。报告中展示了其安全基准评估表现，为开源安全防护模型与合规审核提供了全新的技术参考与评估基线。

后训练，指在预训练模型基础上通过指令微调或强化学习进行特定任务优化
推理模型，具有思维链与复杂逻辑推理能力的大语言模型
